question: With the trust region removed (DELTA_WEIGHT=0), the closed-form solve is finally free to drive its own reconstruction objective toward zero. Does token cross-entropy follow it down?
variable_under_test: DELTA_WEIGHT=0 vs 1e-2 (DIAG-OBJ-b). All else held: TOP_T=511, RIDGE_LAMBDA=0, RIDGE_SCALE=spectral, GRANULARITY=per_layer, SLOT_SELECTION=tfidf, USE_IDF=0, KEY_MODE=freeze, TARGET_MODE=cartridge_plus_doc, AM_EXECUTION_MODE=per_document.
baseline_ref: DIAG-OBJ-b (QA 2.5133 / MT 2.6630 standalone; mean am/mean_mse 0.09155). Secondary: DIAG-OBJ-a = EXP-007-top32 canonical (QA 2.1772 / MT 2.5524; mean am/mean_mse 0.11906).

diagnostics.verdict_shape: MSE collapsed 94.5% (18.2x better fit) while BOTH eval CEs exploded by ~13.3-13.5 loss. Not 'MSE->0 with flat CE' and not 'CE follows MSE' - the two are anti-correlated in this regime.
diagnostics.am_mean_mse_definition: F.mse_loss(alpha_new @ V_new, target) in attention-output space, averaged over heads then over the 36 layers, on the run's OWN reference queries (cartridges/am/value_solve.py). DELTA_WEIGHT=0 + no old-ref guard routes finetune.py to sparse_am_value_update (stats['mse']) instead of guarded_sparse_am_value_update (stats['mse_new']) - identical quantity, different branch.

L34_L35.reading: The trust region - not top_t and not ridge - was what pinned layers 34/35: at DELTA_WEIGHT=1e-2 they held 95.4% of the residual and shrank only 0.93x/0.77x; at DELTA_WEIGHT=0 they fell by 4-5 orders of magnitude to 0.43% of the residual.

numerical_health.diverged_note: Nothing is NaN/Inf and the solve did not error: every per-document MSE and every cache tensor is finite in bf16. The blow-up is a magnitude blow-up, not an overflow: trainable value max|v| = 21504 vs 984 at the canonical top32 point (21.9x) and 848 at DIAG-OBJ-b (25.4x), concentrated in layers 32 (21504), 20 (16000), 31 (8096), 7 (6496).

observations: Removing the trust region worked exactly as intended on the solve's own objective and catastrophically on the model: with DELTA_WEIGHT=0 (single change vs DIAG-OBJ-b) the mean am/mean_mse over the 16 documents fell from 0.09155 to 0.005037 (-94.5%, ratio 0.055) and the last document's value from 0.16873 to 0.0011733 (-99.3%), improving on ALL 16 documents (per-doc ratio range 0.0024-0.706); this is the closest to MSE->0 this objective has reached, 95.8% below the canonical top32 operating point. Token cross-entropy went the opposite way by an enormous margin: MT acquisition 2.6630 -> 15.9504 and QA forgetting 2.5133 -> 16.0084 (standalone eval_forgetting.py on the run's own cache_last.pt; the in-run evals agree at 15.9227 / 16.0286), i.e. +13.29 and +13.50 loss, roughly the CE of a destroyed cartridge (ppl ~8e6). The layers that refused to shrink in every previous run collapsed completely: layer 34 went 4.0764 -> 0.00015503 (3.80e-05x) and layer 35 1.7208 -> 0.00002726 (1.58e-05x), so the share of per-layer residual held by L34+L35 dropped from 95.44% to 0.43% and the other 34 layers also improved (mean 0.008152 -> 0.001237, ratio 0.152); the trust region, not capacity or ridge, was what pinned L34/L35 - 9 of 36 layers are nonetheless slightly WORSE than DIAG-OBJ-b (worst: L25 486x, L7 209x, L31 100x), so the improvement is a large net win concentrated in the deep layers rather than a uniform one. Nothing diverged in the numerical sense: no NaN or Inf anywhere in the 16 per-document MSEs or in any cache tensor, and the solve returned rc=0 in 173.1s (solve wall) with 511/511 slots selected per layer and 0 gradient steps - but the written values blew up in magnitude, value_global_max_abs = 21504.0 versus 984.0 at top32 (21.9x) and 848.0 at DIAG-OBJ-b (25.4x), concentrated in layers 32 (21504), 20 (16000), 31 (8096) and 7 (6496) while the keys (frozen) stayed at 302. So the fit improved by ~18x on the solve's own reference queries while both eval splits collapsed by ~13.3 loss, which is a decoupling result of the anti-correlated kind rather than the flat-CE kind. Noise caveat: the eval splits are tiny (QA n=6 batches, MT n=5) and sub-0.1-0.2 loss deltas are noise, but the +13.3/+13.5 deltas here are ~70x the noise floor and the MSE reduction is monotone across all 16 documents, so neither direction is attributable to eval noise.
